messages:
dina: flagging a steady ~3.9% gap between invoice-preview and ledger starting ~04:22 UTC. preview shows clusters of the same request_id counted twice; ledger seems to have deduped them. this started right after the dedupe-key change rolled. anyone on dedupe pipeline? :alarm_clock:

kevin: I rolled the dedupe-key change at 04:20 to switch from sha1(request_id) -> sha256(tenant_id+":"+request_id) so multi-tenant collisions are reduced. suspect mismatch: preview still computing old key in the emit path while ledger uses new key on ingest.

sophia: confirmed on a small sample: preview events have dedupe_key="sha1:abc123..." and ledger rows have dedupe_key="sha256:ff7a..." for the same request_id. so preview cannot match ledger dedupe set -> double-count in preview.

dina: mitigation plan (short): 1) ship a shim that emits both keys (legacy_key + canonical_key) in meter events behind a FF at 0.5% traffic so we can measure mapping; 2) dashboard with `preview_dup_ratio` and alert if >1.01 for 20m; 3) short backfill for the 2h window using access-log join to emit correction events to preview pipeline (no invoice mutation).

kevin: shim sketch (Go):
```go
legacy := sha1.Sum([]byte(reqID))
canonical := sha256.Sum256([]byte(tenant+":"+reqID))
meta["dedupe_legacy"] = fmt.Sprintf("sha1:%x", legacy)
meta["dedupe_canonical"] = fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", canonical)
emitMeterEvent(ctx, payload, meta)
```
Feature-flagged + sampling RNG. will open PR now.

sophia: also adding telemetry counters: `billing.dedupe.unmatched_preview` and `billing.dedupe.preview_to_ledger_ratio`. Create alert: preview/ledger > 1.01 for 20m -> page billing-oncall.

deploy-bot: staging deploy of feature/dual-dedupe-shim succeeded  build 4759 (staging).

dina: after staging validation (24h), canary to prod at 1% for 4h. if stable, we run a backfill for the incident window to populate canonical dedupe keys in preview state so the preview/ledger numbers reconcile for auditors. coordinate with invoice-audit before backfill.

kevin: will own the PR and the backfill job. sophia please add runbook entry "dedupe-key migration mismatch" with triage steps and the new metrics/dashboard links.

sophia: will update runbook and add the dashboard card. will post canary metrics in this thread. thanks. :thumbsup:
